selection: Domains in listed order. Sort remaining parents by SHA256(seed newline domain newline original source name), name tie-break. Deterministic2049-token window at hash(... newline window) modulo eligible offsets. No EOT added.
dedup: Reject any32-token exact BLAKE2b128 span matching original train/val within-document index or any previously selected excerpt in either domain. No alternative window after rejection. Original test never consulted.
underfill: Reject whole dataset if either domain lacks8 accepted fresh parents. No model scoring before complete fixed manifest.
limits: Exact32-token overlap only; paraphrases/shorter overlaps remain possible. PG19 historical books and mechanically filtered Python prose are narrow domain probes.
